Links the agreed rate model to the project before syncing its tasks.
Sends one e-mail when project tasks were skipped. Create Event — Sends the e-mail listing the skipped tasks.
Sends an e-mail stating that the agreed rate model was not found and no tasks were created.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Links the existing SPM tasks to the Xero tasks by name.
Gets the project tasks from Xero and creates the new ones.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Regular project: gets the rate model and syncs the tasks.
Returns the tasks created for this project.
Legacy projects only get their tasks linked by name.
Legacy projects do not create tasks.
Runs when the agreed rate model was not found.
Reads the agreed rate model sys_id from the system property.
Tasks are only created when the agreed rate model exists.
Sends one e-mail when project tasks were skipped.
Returns 0 because no tasks were created without the agreed rate model.
